battle at the ministry.ecvDetailNote: Queue is elevator-equipped through the Métro-Floo. Transfer from ECV to a standard wheelchair or transfer directly at the separate stationary load platform.
battle at the ministry.description: Travel by Métro-Floo from 1920s Paris into the British Ministry of Magic for Dolores Umbridge's trial aboard omnidirectional lift vehicles.

monsters unchained.ecvDetailNote: Transfer from ECV to a courtesy manual wheelchair before the locker bay. Ask Team Members for the stationary load platform to avoid the moving walkway.
monsters unchained.description: Descend into the catacombs beneath Frankenstein Manor as Dr. Victoria Frankenstein's experiment unleashes Count Dracula and classic Universal monsters.

stardust racers.ecvDetailNote: All loose items including phones must go into free lockers before metal detectors. Elevator access to load platform with standard coaster transfer.
stardust racers.description: Board a comet on this dual-launch racing coaster reaching 62 mph and 133 feet, featuring an inverted crisscross maneuver over Celestial Park.

mario kart.ecvDetailNote: Transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue or use the elevator to the load platform. Accessible kart with a wide opening is available upon request.
mario kart.description: Put on augmented-reality goggles inside Bowser's Castle to steer, throw shells, and race Team Bowser across iconic Mario Kart courses.

mine-cart madness.ecvDetailNote: Transfer from ECV to a courtesy wheelchair for the queue. Ride vehicle requires stepping over a side wall into the mine cart.
mine-cart madness.description: Help Donkey Kong and Diddy Kong protect the Golden Banana on a track-jumping coaster that leaps across broken rails.

hiccup's wing gliders.ecvDetailNote: Store loose bags in the free lockers near the entrance. Transfer from ECV to a manual wheelchair for the queue and step into the glider seat.
hiccup's wing gliders.description: Launch across the lagoon and village of Berk aboard Hiccup's latest winged contraption alongside Toothless and other dragons.

curse of the werewolf.ecvDetailNote: Standard queue wheelchair transfer. Ride cars spin freely during the coaster launches through the dark forest.
curse of the werewolf.description: Weave through the dark woods outside Darkmoor Village on a spinning family thrill coaster while escaping a pack of werewolves.

hagrid.ecvDetailNote: Transfer to a manual wheelchair at the entrance. Request the stationary offline load platform—the Sidecar is much easier to step into than the Motorbike.
hagrid.description: Join Hagrid's Care of Magical Creatures class on a motorbike or sidecar across seven launches, a reverse track, and a surprise vertical drop.

velocicoaster.ecvDetailNote: Double-sided lockers are built into the queue just before the metal detectors. Elevator access to load platform with standard coaster transfer.
velocicoaster.description: Race alongside a pack of Velociraptors through the paddock with two high-speed launches up to 70 mph and a 155-foot top hat.

forbidden journey.ecvDetailNote: Transfer to a manual wheelchair at the castle entrance. Ask Team Members for the stationary load platform to bypass the moving walkway.
forbidden journey.description: Soar above Hogwarts grounds, dodge a Hungarian Horntail, and face Dementors on an enchanted bench inside Hogwarts Castle.

incredible hulk.ecvDetailNote: All pockets must be completely empty before passing through metal detectors. Elevator access to the load station.
incredible hulk.description: Blast from 0 to 40 mph in two seconds straight into a zero-G roll and seven intense inversions.

spider-man.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair at the entrance. Scoop vehicles require stepping over a low side rail.
spider-man.description: Board a Daily Bugle Scoop vehicle and wear 3D glasses to swing through New York alongside Spider-Man against the Sinister Syndicate.

reign of kong.ecvDetailNote: Transfer from ECV to a standard wheelchair at the entrance; a dedicated expedition truck allows manual wheelchairs to roll directly onboard.
reign of kong.description: Venture deep into Skull Island aboard a massive expedition truck as prehistoric predators clash with King Kong.

river adventure.ecvDetailNote: Transfer from ECV to a manual wheelchair for the queue, then step down into the raft. Expect a soaking 85-foot plunge.
river adventure.description: Cruise past peaceful dinosaurs before a containment breach sends your raft face-to-face with a T. rex and down an 85-foot drop.

escape from gringotts.ecvDetailNote: Transfer from ECV to a courtesy wheelchair before the bank lobby. Elevator bypasses the stairs to the underground load station.
escape from gringotts.description: Navigate the subterranean vaults of Gringotts Wizarding Bank while dodging Voldemort, Bellatrix, and a fire-breathing dragon.

revenge of the mummy.ecvDetailNote: All bags must be stored in free lockers outside the museum entrance. Elevator access to load platform.
revenge of the mummy.description: Plunge into total darkness on an indoor psychological thrill coaster with fire effects, backwards drops, and a high-speed launch.

transformers.ecvDetailNote: Transfer from ECV to a manual wheelchair at the entrance; elevator provides access to the upper load level.
transformers.description: Join Optimus Prime and Bumblebee inside EVAC to protect the AllSpark from Megatron in a fast-paced 3D battle.

minion mayhem.ecvDetailNote: Stationary accessible seating is available at the front of the theater so guests can remain in their wheelchair without transferring.
minion mayhem.description: Enter Gru's laboratory for chaotic Minion training in a family-friendly motion simulator.

e.t. adventure.ecvDetailNote: Manual wheelchairs can roll directly onto a dedicated spaceship vehicle; ECV users transfer to a courtesy wheelchair.
e.t. adventure.description: Board a flying bicycle to help E.T. return to the Green Planet in Universal Studios Florida's classic opening-day dark ride.

men in black.ecvDetailNote: Store bags in the free lockers at the entrance. Transfer from ECV to a manual wheelchair for the queue.
men in black.description: Zap aliens across New York streets with your laser blaster and compete for the highest agent score.

krakatau.ecvDetailNote: Uses TapuTapu virtual line return times. Guests must transfer into the four-person canoe raft.
krakatau.description: Twist, plunge, and propel uphill through the misty interior of the Krakatau volcano on a magnetic water coaster.

untrainable.description: A live dragon-filled stage production featuring Hiccup, Toothless, Gobber, and Astrid soaring above the audience.

cirque arcanus.description: Step inside the traveling magical circus in 1920s Paris featuring live performers, aerialists, puppetry, and fantastic beasts.

bourne stuntacular.description: Cutting-edge fusion of live stunt performers, massive LED projection screens, and automated set pieces following Jason Bourne.

horror make-up.description: Fast-paced comedy demonstration revealing the special-effects secrets behind Universal's classic movie monsters.

animal actors.description: Live outdoor amphitheater show starring rescued dogs, birds, and animal performers.

blues brothers.description: Jake and Elwood Blues perform classic soul and rhythm & blues hits live on the streets of New York.

celestina warbeck.description: The Singing Sorceress and her Banshees perform jazzy wizarding hits live on the Carkitt Market stage.

frog choir.description: Hogwarts students from all four houses perform a cappella wizarding songs accompanied by giant bass-croaking frogs.

cinesational.description: Nighttime lagoon spectacular featuring fountains, 4K water projection mapping, lasers, pyrotechnics, and 600+ drones.
